decisions.reason: The closed baseline shows all six incident labels and c’s exact unavailable reason, plus title, subtitle, notice, summary, primary label and entire footer. Collapsed guidance and incident dossiers are intentionally excluded. In the original overlapping viewport PNGs, all required characters remain readable; lines expand vertically without clipping or ellipsis. Character fallback in narrow text is accepted for segments that exceed the available width. Exact-state native interval coverage is complete.

However frozen bound_state_evidence reports incomplete per-state interval union: the last interval ends at 1640 while native content height is 1646. Complete exact-state coverage is required for a true full-content judgment; I do not turn the visible bottom sentinel/footer into proof of the unobserved remainder. Unknown is retained; this is not a supported F and receives no failure-cause attribution.
